script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say that nobody argued or asked for time to think.
“The old excuse is gone” claims the people no longer held that view, which the passage does not state.
“Warned” and “sent” are not close in sound. His observations must be true.
Saying the message stung asserts a reaction the text does not give, without marking it as his guess.
Saying the people heard the message “straight from Him” obscures that Haggai delivered it.
The house lying in ruins is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference to Haggai 1:4 or 1:9.
The text says the work began, but does not say the finish was still a long way off.
Saying they came “not to look things over” adds a purpose the text does not give.
The identification of Cyrus as king of Persia is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
